headline: OJK: Capital market maintains its role as a source of financing amid global turmoil
summary: OJK chairperson Friderica Widyasari Dewi said the Indonesian capital market continues to serve as a source of financing despite global turmoil. The statement came from the financial regulator.
why: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) regulates Indonesia's capital markets, banks and non-bank financial institutions, and its stance shapes investor confidence in Jakarta-listed assets.
